nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Face Scrub

avis.texte: I hAVE BEEN USING THIS cLINIQUE I have been using this Clinique "scrub" for the past 20 years. My daughter was a Clinique specialist at the time and got me started on the use of this product. I highly recommend to all men.
Perfect for men to get that smooth look and great for oily skin!!

This is a great scrub. However, you should know that this is a very aggressive scrub. I only use this in my T-zone area, which is where I'm mostly oily at and I have large pores at. The scrub completely clears my pores and makes my skin feel so glossy and clean. However, I don't think I will use this on my beard. I have a sensitive beard, and I could only scrub the same area of my face 1-2 times with it because of how harsh it was exfoliating. This is a literal scrub with no lubricant other than water to mix with it. So while I would recommend this to others, I wouldn't recommend it to someone with sensitive skin unless they had a specific area to scrub.
Something has change… less gritty and does not have the invigorating sensation it used too. Still works but I most likely will look for something else once this runs out.

I would have given it 5 stars if it were as gritty as it used to be. I'm a woman and I have us ed for many years. I liked it more when it was grittier. Like so many other great products…..the environmentalists have ruined this product too. 👎🏻
I got this for my boyfriend because he received a travel size for Christmas. He has oily skin so this works great for him.

I've been using Clinique for Men Face Scrub for over 20 years. I started using it in college to fight acne and I still love it too keep my face clean, bright, and now instead of acne I use it to fight signs of aging. I wish so many other products by other manufacturers still existed. Many other companies (Redken and Kiehl's) have discontinued or changed the formulas of their products, but Clinique has remained high quality and effective. I highly recommend this as an every other day exfoliating scrub.
This face scrub is amazing, another wonderful product by Clinique! It removes all the dirt, oil, and dead skin to reveal healthy, soft, and smooth skin.

avis.auteur: Don't get from Ulta because bad shipping
avis.texte: This packaging is smaller and just as expensive, that was disappointing

LOVE this face scrub! Have been using it off & on for 30+ years. I've tried other scrubs from most of the prestige skincare brands & I always come back to this Clinique face scrub for men. The 3.4 oz tube lasts about 1 month with 2 people using it daily.

avis.titre: Really great scrub and great price
avis.texte: My boyfriend loves it !! Makes your skin super clean and doesn't irritate

I love using this, particularly before shaving. It's also not as abrasive and rough on the skin at other brands and rinses off easily. The only con is that the container makes it difficult for it to come out. I'm not sure if it was the product inside the tube or if it was the tube itself but you really have to squeeze to get it out.

This product has really made a huge difference in my boyfriend's face. It has really helped to keep his face exfoliated which has resulted in a smoother shave. I wish they made it in a bigger size because he goes through it quickly.

avis.titre: I will continue to buy this product!
avis.texte: I use this product 2-3 times a week. It is excellent at controlling my oily skin.
My construction worker hubby loves this. It has good grit and leaves his skin glowing.

Got a deluxe sample for my hubby. He reported that the scrub was fine, gentle and refreshing. That's all I needed to hear from a man who typically favors scent-free drugstore products – so I purchased the full size.

avis.titre: I don't think I'm supposed to use this product this way!
avis.texte: Yes I use this to exfoliate my face. However at the same time I also use it. Best shaving cream I have ever used. I've been using it for 25 years now just hate using anything else!

I know this is called a men's product, but I'm a woman and I love it. I was using the women's exfoliating scrub for years. One day when I went to pick up a tube, they were out of it and suggested I try the men's scrub. I loved it!! They say it's the same product, but this feels just a little grittier, which I love!! I'm in my 60's and I still love using and exfoliating scrub. I have no use for the 7 Day Scrub at all......totally useless.....why even bother if that's what you're going to use. But this is a great product!! I get compliments on my skin all the time!!

I have used this product for 3-4 years now, and use it three times per week along with other Clinique Men's skin care products. I has helped my skin significantly in appearance compared to other products I discontinued.

I use this every day and my face has never looked better. I was to a point I had no idea what else to try, and I found this shoved in one of my sample bags. I figured, nothing could make it worse, and by the next day my skin was noticeably clearer. By the way, I am not my husband. So this product works well on women too!!

This is the BEST scrub for oily skin. Has almost solid grit that actually makes you feel like you are removing dry, dull skin with little to no creaminess. A little goes a long way. I've tried many as a replacement and am never satisfied. This is the one!

So I got a sample use of it and I really like it. I think women can use this too. I use it around my nose and chin. It not too harsh that it the best face scrub I ever use. All the scrub I use before were all useless can't scrub anything out

My husband's skin starting getting blotchy now that he is in his mid 40s. I wanted to help him find a product to help with the uneven complexion and oiliness without a lot of steps. The product worked and he was consistent about using it while in the shower. I bought the scrub and charcoal cleanser.
I bought this for my boyfriend since he had been asking for a facial scrub, he tried it and loved it. He said it left his face smooth and clean after the first try, great smell too.
He uses it i the shower and has nothing but good things to say about it
My daughter uses this product for he acne prone skin and has found the men's product to be even more effective.
My husband loves this face wash. I wish it came in a larger size. He tried the cream wash and didn't care for it. The scrub is a must have.
THE best, its so easy to scrub off a new pimple with this, REALLY deflakes troubled skin. Smells great. Great scrub for shaving, great product overall.

I bought this for my boyfriend when it was on promo at half off and he loves it. His skin looks so much better. He's tried dermalogica and other products that have not been as affective. This is the first product that I have bought for him twice.

avis.titre: Bought for my husband for Christmas and he loves it!
avis.texte: Only skin care product my husband asked me to buy again for him!

Exfoliating in the shower has been part of my husband's routine for a long time. He thought he was getting the job done and seeing results with two drugstore brands he used for years. I originally got a sample of this in an ULTA order and he immediately hijacked it. He is hooked, it is moisturizing, effective, yet gentle. When they went on sale for the Love Your Skin Event, we happily stocked up for the year!
A nice, gentle, effective scrub. Not too abrasive so I'm able to use it 3 to 4 times a week in the morning before I shower. Leaves my face feeling fresh and clean.

Bought this for my son at the recommendation of the Clinique rep at my local Ulta. He'd been using 7 Day Scrub cream and liked it a lot, but the Clinique rep suggested the Men's Face Scrub instead, since men's skin is different than a woman's, and they have a beard to contend with. Told my son to try it out and he loves it even more than the 7 day. It has a little bit rougher of a grit, which he finds preferable, but it's been gentle enough to use frequently. Leaves his skin very soft and clean.
Best exfoliator I have ever used. I like real fine exfolliants that really scrub, and. Is one delivered. To top it off, it has a nice cooling feel after using.

I've been using this scrub for a little over 4 years now and I absolutely love it. I use it every other day and it leaves my face and beard feeling clean and airy. It works perfectly for a pre-shave prep as well! Totally worth it.
Bought this for my husband and he was amazed how clean and soft his face felt.
I only use a small amount of it and it does a good job. Most of this men's brand's skin care products are good.
My husband is not big on using facial products, but I got this in a set for him for Christmas and he loves it. Used the coupon to go buy him the full size.

I got this as a gift and love the way it leaves my skin feeling: as smooth as a baby's bottom. Especially when I combine it with Cliniques other anti aging products/moisturizers. I did break out when I first started using it, but I think that just tells you how much was built up in my pores. Love it and will continue to use it!
This product works great to help guard against razor burn if you use it before you shave .
I use it about three times a week to really deep clean and exfoliate my face. Works great
My husband uses this daily and I borrow it about once a week. Great scrub!

avis.titre: One Of The Best Scrubs On The Market
avis.texte: This is what a facial scrub should be, thick with lots of grit. My skin is oily and I am prone to ingrown hairs and clogged pores. Just using this scrub alone improved my skin about 70%. Adding a glycolic cleanser and the clinique oil control moisturizer did the rest. I get many compliments on my skin. I have been using this scrub for about 5 years. I tried other less expensive brands and the quality and performance were just not there. Also, this one is eco-friendly.
I love using this man exfoliating product, I prefer it over the one for women, it leaves the face feeling minty fresh!!!!! It preps the skin so nice if you use it before applying makeup

avis.titre: One of the grittiest scrubs I've used.
avis.texte: Has lots of grit for great exfoliation, plus leaves skin with a cool minty feel. I've been using this one for years.

avis.titre: I've used this product for many years and continue to.
avis.texte: I have used this product every morning in the shower, prior to shaving, and it I get compliments on my skin often. I am told I look many years younger than I am, and I know that my Clinique regimen has had a lot to do with that.

I buy this for my boyfriend and he loves it. For some reason, this product is always sold out around me and even online. I now have to buy THREE at a time just to make sure we have some. This is a great face scrub!

avis.titre: My fiance asked for this product
avis.texte: I do not personally use this. My fiance uses it and he loves how his face feels. So I cannot speak for him on the specifics of this product. Guys should try it :)

This is a great scrub. However, the photo Ulta currently uses is misleading. The tube is actually quite short, and almost looks like the size of a deluxe sample. So, I had to take off a star for the price to amount of product ratio being off.

avis.titre: Perfect for loosening course facial hair
avis.texte: I use this product before shaving and it really helps cut down on the drag from my razor. I have pretty course facial hair and before using this product would see a lot of irritation under my nose and on my cheeks after shaving. I've been using this product for about 2 months and see almost no irritation and experience a faster and smoother shave. I also use this scrub all over my face to help remove dry skin and black heads on and around my nose (I'm very prone to getting black heads). This product is very effective and still gentle enough for my sensitive skin for me to use 2-3 times a week.

This is my favorite scrub ever!! Menthol-y scent wakes me up, and the tiny scrubbing beads are gentle but make my skin feel smooth & clean. A bit cost prohibitive, but every time I purchase, I am glad I did. Most scrubs are a tube of cream with some scrubby beads in it..this is mostly scrubbly beads, with just enough cream to transport out of the tube, therefore very little is used for each application, which btw is every day for me..it is gentle enough for daily use! Love!!

I am a 49 year old man that's been using clinique men's scrub for twenty five years daily. It gets rid of all the dead skin and gives your skin a younger look. Most people think I am twenty years younger than I really am. It is very grandular and you can feel it taking away all the dead skin and dirt. I stand by this product 100%.

avis.titre: Great scrub for the guys AND the gals!
avis.texte: My husband and I have been using this product for several years. It leaves your face fresh and glowing but not dry. A great way to take care of the daily buildup of facial creams. We use this 2-3 times a week.
Fiancee really likes have used a few times but has a manly smell.
My husband loves this product!!! He has been using it for several years!
I am a woman and use this product and so does my husband. The fine granules for the exfoliant is gentle enough to leave my skin smooth and not dry.
Fresh scent that leaves your face extra clean but is gentle on skin

I bought this product for my son. His comments are: "I use the product daily to help with occasional breakouts. This product keeps the skin smooth, no breakouts. Shaving is much easier. The only complaint I have is: cost.

Aesthetician recommended this scrub to me due to my very oily skin & clogged pores. LOVE LOVE LOVE!!! For all you ladies that appreciate the texture and performance of a grainy exfoliating Sscrub--THIS IS IT!! Back-to basics scrub--lots of grains, not scratchy but you will feel it and get real results- 3 days' use will provide you with measurable results. And a little goes a long way---this tube should last at least 8 weeks. EXCELLENT PRODUCT!! YOU WILL NOT BE DISAPPOINTED!!!
This is a great product, the only thing we would suggest would be to have a gift set year round and not only during the holidays.
This product [...]was hard to squeeze out and felt dry. works okay, smells clean.

avis.titre: Perfect Exfoliant to keep Skin Fresh!
avis.texte: boyfriend and I use this twice a week and it keeps my skin fresh, clean, and glowing! Have recently had some acne issues and this helps keep pores clean. Has a minty feel and doesn't have a particular male fragrance.

I use this product every other day. It's a great complexion enhancer. It also is great for combination skin. It softens and leaves a nice refreshing, minty feeling. I love the way this product makes my face feel! I use in conjuction with clinique mens face soap and scruffing lotion.
My husband loves this product and has commented on how he has not used as many razors since using this product!

I bought this for my husband who works out in the desert sun, wind and heat. There is a constant grit in the air out here that covers him head to toe by the end of his work day. Clinique Facial Scrub does a fantastic job cutting through the dirt and grit on his face w/o causing redness and further irritation after a day in the sun. Clinique Daily Hydration is the perfect companion product.

avis.titre: Finally, I found one that I like
avis.texte: I use this every other day. It even gets in my facial hair. It's swell.
